Or rather, is it really fine for me to be the only one relaxing here?
Isn't there something I can do...?

Believe's grandfather graciously agreed to meet with me during her provisional contract,
even though I visited out of the blue. ...I'd like to greet him properly once more.

On my day off, just as I stepped outside to head out—
I bumped right into Believe!

Yes, of course. All I can do is prepare an environment
where they can concentrate like that...
As for the thickness... guess I'll shave it down now.

Ah... well, yes.
I'll ask him.

Every piece he showed me looked like a beautiful interior ornament.
A vase decorated with delicate patterns, a rustic castle planter...

My husband has also... taken a liking to making single-flower vases and planters lately.
Using leftover scraps from work, wasn't it, dear?

Yeah. Even with buildings, we often get requests for wall patterns.
It's an application of plastering techniques.

Honest, steady hands performing delicate work in silence.
A focused gaze facing beautiful "craftsmanship" with total dedication, honing it to perfection.

Hehe... those two really are something...
—Ah, I'm sorry, Trainer. It must be quite boring for you, isn't it?
Come here, I'll show you the whole lot.

Just because I carelessly said, "Maybe Believe could make one too,"
things have turned into quite a situation...

Hehe, indeed...
Those two grow more alike with each passing year, you know.

Though their expressions are rugged,
both of them look somewhat full of life.

Please, come right on in. My husband is home, too.
...Believe, it's been a while. How have you been? Are you eating properly?

Yeah.
They serve meals at the dorm, so I'm fine.

They're truly stunning... Someday, Believe will silently hone her craft
and create works like these too... No, not just someday—

This one's a planter.
The motif is a castle. The container's a stone wall, and the back is a house ornament.
Hmph... Shall we make one, Believe?

I want to become someone who can quietly, gently support
that craftsmanship... and this precious time. Someday, I hope to—

...Grandpa, can I start mixing the mortar now?
I still remember the ratio.
...It's just "work." It's nothing special.
What about this one? The pattern... is it mortar art?

Assemble the frame carefully so the mortar doesn't wobble.
Keep a clear image of the finished piece in your head.

Hehe... Dear, you finished a few pieces recently, didn't you?
Why don't you show them? To the Trainer as well, if they'd like.

Yeah. —Ah, this joint doesn't fit well.
I need to shave this board down more...

Um, Grandpa.
What did you use as the mold for this single-flower vase base?

Thickness, huh... —Right, thinner looks cleaner...
Taking strength into account too... about that much... that feel... —Alright.

—!
No... I mean, I'd like to try making one, but...

...It's just putting leftover materials to good use.
There are plenty of ways to use 'em.

I got carried away explaining—and when I glance over at Believe,
she has an awkward expression. ...Was I being annoying?

I designed it by piecing together leftover wood scraps.
You could even use milk cartons for it.

It's quite alright. Normally, that's what anyone would do. But—
those two... they simply won't accept any help, you see.

Turn 'em into knick-knacks, and there's always someone who wants 'em.
That's all it is.
—Can't settle down?

From the cooking stove at the training camp to the academy's flowerbed,
she worked in silence to repair them, executing each task flawlessly.
Listening to her words, I gaze at the "craftsmanship" unfolding between Believe and her grandfather.
...Do you think so...?

Oh, my...
—Hehe, a flowerbed? What a coincidence.
Ah, yes. I came to visit Grandpa... my grandparents.

The flowerbed... didn't turn out that well.
...I'm not satisfied with it.

Seeing Believe speak in a tone somewhat gentler than usual warms my heart.
...I can't help but wonder if I'll ever be able to reach that level of closeness with her, too.

—I want to see.
Grandpa, could you show us?
He's temporarily back in the country right now, staying at this house.

—It seems it's all right.
...Then, right this way.

......Your Trainer is quite an eccentric one.
Reminds me of my old lady a bit.

Oh my, welcome.
Thank you so much for always taking such good care of our granddaughter.
Amazing——...

Still, you see... if you just wait quietly in silence...
he will show you some truly exquisite "work."

Once he enters into his "work,"
it becomes a world where only he and the "work" exist. ...No one can interfere.

A single-flower vase. The frame over here is simple enough, but
if you get clever with the molds, you can make things like this too.

(Clink, clink, clink, clink... tap, tap...
—Swish, swish...)

You make a cube, without being off by even a fraction of a millimeter.
Adding value to it as a one-of-a-kind piece comes much later.

Believe, it seems you're busy crafting all sorts of things at the academy too, aren't you?
...Fufu, you've really grown so splendidly.
